北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京天气晴好，但风力 5 级，注意防风保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is clear, but windy at 5 levels. Stay warm and mind the wind!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天有风，体感 13℃ 比较凉，记得添衣哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and breezy, feeling cool at 13℃. Don't forget an extra layer!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感 17℃ 宜人，出门注意防晒哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is partly cloudy, feeling pleasant at 17℃. Don't forget sun protection!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，湿度高达 88%，感觉有点闷热，注意补水哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy with 88% humidity. It feels muggy, remember to hydrate!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 30℃ 炎热，湿度也高，多喝水防中暑！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feeling a hot 30℃ with high humidity. Drink water to avoid heatstroke!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 14℃ 有些凉，风力 4 级，注意保暖哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, feeling cool at 14℃ with a 4-level wind. Stay warm!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，风力 4 级，体感 17℃ 略凉，小心别着凉。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy with a 4-level wind. It feels cool at 17℃, take care not to catch a cold!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 17℃ 挺舒服的，湿度 59%，适宜出行。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feeling quite comfortable at 17℃ with 59% humidity. Good for going out.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 22℃ 刚刚好，湿度适中，保持好心情。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feeling just right at 22℃ with moderate humidity. Keep smiling!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 23℃ 舒适宜人，注意防晒，享受好天气。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is partly cloudy, feeling comfortable at 23℃. Enjoy the good weather and protect from sun.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 16℃ 偏凉，湿度 69%，出行记得带伞哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feeling cool at 16℃ with 69% humidity. Don't forget your umbrella!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，风力 5 级，体感 13℃ 较凉，注意防风保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is partly cloudy and windy at 5 levels. It feels cool at 13℃, dress warmly!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗有风，体感 15℃ 稍凉，记得增添衣物哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is clear and breezy, feeling a bit cool at 15℃. Remember to add a layer!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 14℃ 较冷，湿度 80%，注意防潮保暖。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feeling cold at 14℃ with 80% humidity. Stay warm and dry!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阵雨，体感 14℃ 湿冷有风，注意保暖带雨具。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen has showers, feeling wet, cold and windy at 14℃. Stay warm and bring rain gear!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，风力 4 级，体感 15℃ 稍凉，记得加件外套哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is partly cloudy with a 4-level wind. It feels a bit cool at 15℃, bring a jacket!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗有风，体感 16℃ 稍凉，多穿一点，别着凉了。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is clear and breezy, feeling cool at 16℃. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!
